# phrase: # Non-lexical aux/modal+verb fragments from libchewing that steal a syllable
# from a stronger straddling word (e.g. 會比 vs 比較). Capped to w(lead)+w(stolen)-0.3.
# Reviewed against MOE revised dict (offline tool, not redistributed). See README.md.
# V得/A得 fragments (得 = ˙ㄉㄜ complement/degree marker) homophonous with V的/A的.
# The nq reading is correct here (unlike 地); demoting only flips 的-vs-得 disambiguation
# and never breaks 得-assembly (V|得 still types the same text).
# Capped to w(top single at the lead reading)+w(的)-1.0-0.05. The -1.0 pays back the
# walker's per-extra-syllable bonus; without it a two-syllable node outranks the two
# singles even at the cap, which is why 笑得 (no 笑的 entry to outrank it) still won.
# The anchor is the top single at the lead reading, not the fragment's own first char,
# so a stronger homophone there (望 over 忘, 率 over 綠) is what has to be cleared.
# nq-final V得/A得 fragments found by the full-Viterbi sweep of every nq-final 得/地 entry
# (tmp/de-sweep). Same cap formula as the batch above. Entries whose *reading* is wrong
# (得=ㄉㄟˇ, place-地=ㄉㄧˋ) are NOT here — a cap would leave a dead row on the keystrokes,
# so those go to chiaki-modern-overlay/explicit.tsv as an exact-pair reading-demote instead.
# 你得 moved there too: it is 你ㄉㄟˇ, not a V得 complement.
# 已變得 removed: chiaki-web-overlay/bigrams.tsv has `UO 8inq 已 變得`, and
# joined_phrase_records_from_bigrams re-synthesises the unigram AFTER this file is
# applied, so the cap was inert. The blocked 以便的 is not a plausible input anyway.
# Any future demotion of a phrase a web-overlay bigram can join needs the same check.
